Concrete Lines

Mega park. Drop in from a 22-metre tower, clear the mega gap, carve the arena, then head south to the sky zone: ride the giant spiral rails up into a bowl floating 25 m in the air. Out on the wings: a 230 m mega half pipe with a loop-de-loop, sky rails, and a pool. Find the S-K-A-T-E letters and the secret tape.
